How it works

A clear next step.
Every time you return.

A roadmap gives your agent direction. Magistr keeps the plan and the work together, from the first idea to the last passing check.

01
Make a plan.

Break the project into manageable steps. Give each one a clear goal and the checks it needs to pass.

02
Work through it.

Let your agent take one ready step, make the change and run its checks. You choose when to continue.

03
Come back to it.

Start a fresh session with the saved plan, completed work and test results ready to read.

magistr next

Continue unfinished work, or complete one ready step.

Get started

Bring a project.

Magistr is in preview for Apple Silicon Macs. Registry packages are not published yet; building from source requires repository access.

macOS 15 or later · Rust 1.95 or later

Full installation guide
→

Install from source

git clone https://github.com/AlrikOlson/magistr.git
cd magistr
cargo install --locked --path crates/magistr-cli
magistr --version
01
Set up your project

magistr init . helps you choose your agents and review the setup.

02
Check the connection

magistr doctor . checks everything is ready and helps fix connection problems.

03
Plan your first step

Launch your agent and use the starter prompt. Setup does not start implementation.
